description.label: Description
description.value:
Minor Mental Mutation

Your mind embraces its wild side and shun the gilded cage of civilization. While you retain all your mental faculties you adopt animal behaviours, such as growling, eating with your hands, ignoring proper clothing and hygiene. You enjoy the company of animals, preferably wild beasts, and they seem to tolerate you too. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.9fq6p9Q6H02LjaSi]{Animal Affinity} Talent. You can only gain this mutation once.
